yog: Yog spent many years studying with the Wizards of Bracada, though war texts drew him more often than books on magic. When the Duke of Krewlod offered him a military command, Yog gladly accepted: at last, his knowledge of war could be put to use.
shiva: Shiva is the youngest of six daughters in a family of circus animal trainers. Unwilling to spend her life in the family business, she left for a mercenary's place in the Krewlod military. There she found a new calling and excelled at it.
krellion: Krellion joined the army as a prizefighter and became so well known that his fans insisted he lead them into battle. It may not have been the smartest decision, but he proved an exceptional leader, especially among ogrekind.
cragHack: A decorated hero in Enroth, Crag Hack grew bored with home and set sail for a new life in Erathia. He was delighted to find the frontier in turmoil: at last, a land where his skills could be put to use.
tyraxor: Already a Wolf Rider captain, Tyraxor was on a long march along the Krewlod–Tatalia border when he sniffed out a Tatalian ambush. He was not yet among Krewlod's heroes; the discovery earned him that standing.
gird: Gird learned most of what she knows from her hometown Shaman. It is assumed she would have taken his place, but the Magi of Krewlod took her from her village while searching for children able to wield magic.
vey: Vey is an Ogre Mage whose command skills are unparalleled, as he has proven time and again. Should the Duke's son ever falter, Vey would be considered the leading candidate to succeed to Krewlod's throne.
dessa: Nearly fifteen years ago, human marauders massacred Dessa's village. He was one of only six children to survive. Since then, he has dreamed of repaying the humans for their crime; the memory of that loss still shapes his purpose.
terek: Terek spent several years as a strongman at the Circus of the Sun, challenging spectators to throw large rocks farther than he could. One day he lost and was run out of the circus. The man who beat him then recruited him into the Krewlod Army.
gundula: Orphaned at birth, Gundula was raised as a daughter by Duke Boragus. Learning he was not her true father, she joined the military hoping to die an honorable death in battle. It never happened; instead, she became one of its feared leaders.
oris: Oris showed little promise as a mage early in her career. But she can learn nearly any spell she sees cast, an uncanny gift that has more than made up for her apparent lack of magical skill.
